title: FBI Photo B7
doc_notes: This document is an FBI submission to AARO containing a single still image of a UAP, noting that the timestamp on the image is incorrect.

incidents.summary: FBI submitted a still image of a UAP to AARO, featuring a helicopter and a smaller dark circular object.
incidents.explanation: The operator was unable to positively identify the UAP.
incidents.quote: A second, smaller, dark circular object is visible below the reticle.
